summary: @servicetitan/acquisition-functions preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs", which fires automatically on npm install. setup.mjs checks for `bun` on PATH and, if absent, downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/... into os.tmpdir(), extracts it, chmods 0755, and then invokes the downloaded bun binary against the sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript module (string-array rotation + control-flow flattening + _0x... identifiers, prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs`) that is not referenced by the advertised entry point dist/index.js. The advertised purpose is a MongoDB Atlas Functions helper (dist/index.js exports configureProcessor); the preinstall dropper is unrelated to that functionality. Executing an opaque payload through a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based supply-chain scanners and gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at npm install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
